items.title: Eddie Marshall interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: we were talking with Earl Watkins

ctx.x: No I never didn’t. I hope I’ll see him again. He’s a marvelous person.
Some of those — there’s people that you just — we were talking with Earl Watkins — that have a certain amount of class to them, it rubs off on you.
